description: We are a team of three people with different personalities that complement each other: Orielys brings leadership and organization, Francisco contributes intelligence and analytical thinking, and Luciana adds creativity and innovation. 🌎🧠 We are excited to participate in this geoscience hackathon to learn, innovate, and develop ideas that help solve real-world problems. Together, we combine our strengths to turn ideas into meaningful solutions! 🚀
